SkinHandler.IsValidSkin.desc: Returns whether a skin with the given name was loaded successfully.

SkinHandler.GetSkinInfo.desc: Returns a shallow copy of the skin info table; it reads a global skinname (usually nil), so in practice it returns an empty table.
SkinHandler.GetSkinInfo.returns: Copy of the info table, empty when not found.

SkinHandler.GetAvailableSkins.desc: Returns the names of all known skins in load order.

SkinHandler.LoadSkin.desc: Merges the per-class, ancestor-class and general properties of the control.skinName skin and the default skin into control.

params.control: Control to apply the skin properties to.
params.class: Control class (merged level by level along the inherited chain).

module.summary: Skin manager: scan skin folders for skin.lua, resolve depend chains and texture paths, and merge class / parent / general defaults into controls by priority.

fileDesc: Skin management: loads skin.lua configs from the skin directories, resolves depend inheritance and translates image paths, then merges per-class/ancestor/general defaults into controls.
